lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Vertical columns of high-luminance circular clusters organized in approximately 6-8 discernible rows posterior to the branchial region, with spot diameter increasing and spatial density decreasing toward the posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the centers of the circular blobs, creating a structured grid where the vertical bands intersect the horizontal carinae.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear ridges spanning the upper third of the flank, characterized by high-luminance superior edges and shadowed inferior boundaries, maintaining a parallel trajectory relative to the longitudinal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small dark punctate mark or potential parasite attachment site visible at the posterior-ventral junction of the pectoral fin base.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a remora (Echeneidae) attached to the lower lateral flank, ventral to the branchial slits.
